roleRights.leaderWarning: A person who makes a project leads it.
roleRights.aiWhat: What it is: an AI app, such as Claude or ChatGPT, that connects to Madar and works for one person.
roleRights.aiRule: The rule: an assistant never does more than its person may do. These switches only take more away from the assistants of this role.
roleRights.aiNever: An assistant can never: create or delete projects, upload or open files, change people, roles, teams, clients, templates or settings, delete to-dos, edit or delete messages, or send requests and bugs.

projectCreate.label: Create projects
projectCreate.hint: Start a new project, also from a template. The person who makes it leads it.

clientCreate.label: Add clients
clientCreate.hint: Add a new client, for example in the New project form.

projectDetails.label: Change project details
projectDetails.hint: Name, client, location, map pin, area, dates, folder, description, cover and sub-company.

projectTeam.label: Change the team
projectTeam.hint: Add and remove people, and change their discipline in the project.

projectStages.label: Change stages and stage dates
projectStages.hint: Add, remove and order stages. Set their dates and what they wait for.

projectDeadlines.label: Add and change deadlines
projectDeadlines.hint: Add, change and delete the named deadlines of a project.

projectTemplate.label: Apply a template
projectTemplate.hint: Add the stages and to-dos of a project template to an ongoing project.

projectArchive.label: Pause, finish and archive
projectArchive.hint: Pause, resume, finish or archive a project, and set the restart reminder.

projectLeader.label: Hand over to a new leader
projectLeader.hint: Choose a new leader for a project.

projectHealth.label: Set the health by hand
projectHealth.hint: Mark a project On track, At risk or Late by hand.

projectCode.label: Correct the project code
projectCode.hint: Change the code of a project after it is made.

projectDelete.label: Delete projects
projectDelete.hint: Delete a project and everything in it. This has no Undo. A leader cannot do this today.

taskAdd.label: Add to-dos
taskAdd.hint: Add a to-do for yourself or for a team mate.

taskAssign.label: Give to-dos to other people
taskAssign.hint: Name another person as the lead or a helper of a to-do.

taskTake.label: Take a to-do with no lead
taskTake.hint: Become the lead of a to-do that has none.

taskHelp.label: Join as a helper
taskHelp.hint: Help on a to-do of your project with one tap.

taskWork.label: Work on my to-dos
taskWork.hint: Tick, finish, move, order and open a new version of a to-do that you lead or made.

taskDetails.label: Change my to-do details
taskDetails.hint: Change the title, notes, checklist, stage and what a to-do waits for.

taskDates.label: Change to-do dates
taskDates.hint: Move the start date or the due date of a to-do that you lead or made.

taskDeleteOwn.label: Delete my to-dos
taskDeleteOwn.hint: Delete a to-do that you made or lead.

taskAny.label: Change and finish any to-do
taskAny.hint: Change, finish, move or delete any to-do of a project, by anyone.

taskReview.label: Review to-dos
taskReview.hint: Approve a to-do or send it back, and choose if a to-do needs a review.

taskOfficeAll.label: See and manage every office to-do
taskOfficeAll.hint: The private office to-dos of other people. Off keeps them private.

meetingPlan.label: Plan meetings
meetingPlan.hint: Plan a meeting or a site visit.

meetingEditOwn.label: Change and cancel my meetings
meetingEditOwn.hint: Change, cancel or delete a meeting that you organize.

meetingMinutesOwn.label: Write the minutes of my meetings
meetingMinutesOwn.hint: Write the minutes of a meeting that you attended or organized, and add its files.

meetingAny.label: Change and cancel project meetings
meetingAny.hint: Change, cancel or delete any meeting of a project, also when another person organized it.

meetingMinutesAny.label: Write the minutes of project meetings
meetingMinutesAny.hint: Write the minutes of any meeting of a project.

postCreate.label: Post updates
postCreate.hint: Post an update or a decision on a project.

commentCreate.label: Comment and react
commentCreate.hint: Comment on a post or a to-do, and react to a comment.

postEditOwn.label: Edit and delete my posts
postEditOwn.hint: Edit or delete a post or a comment that you wrote.

projectLinks.label: Add and change project links
projectLinks.hint: The moodboard, the office folder, the map and the client delivery folder.

fileUpload.label: Upload files
fileUpload.hint: Add a file or a new version to a project or a to-do.

fileDeliver.label: Mark files delivered or received
fileDeliver.hint: Mark a file as sent to the client or received from the client. This also writes a Tracker line.

fileShare.label: Share files
fileShare.hint: Share a project file into a chat or a to-do.

fileDeleteOwn.label: Delete my files
fileDeleteOwn.hint: Delete a file that you uploaded.

fileDeleteAny.label: Delete any file
fileDeleteAny.hint: Delete any file of a project, by anyone.

chatGroupChange.label: Change groups
chatGroupChange.hint: Rename a group and add people to it.

chatProject.label: Use project chats
chatProject.hint: Read and write in the chat of a project.

trackerLog.label: Log in the Tracker
trackerLog.hint: Log, change and close an exchange with the client.

trackerReply.label: Ask a person to reply
trackerReply.hint: Make a reply to-do for a team mate from a Tracker entry. Also needs the to-do rights.

trackerExport.label: Export the Tracker
trackerExport.hint: Copy or download the Tracker of a project.

trackerDeleteOwn.label: Delete my Tracker entries
trackerDeleteOwn.hint: Delete an entry that you logged.

trackerDeleteAny.label: Delete any Tracker entry
trackerDeleteAny.hint: Delete any entry, also a meeting line that Madar made.

peopleInvite.label: Invite people
peopleInvite.hint: Add a person and send the sign-in email again.

peopleChange.label: Change people
peopleChange.hint: Change the name, discipline and picture of a person.

peopleTeams.label: Make and change teams
peopleTeams.hint: Make, rename and delete the office teams.

peopleTurnOff.label: Turn people off and on
peopleTurnOff.hint: Turn a person off, or on again. Their AI assistants stop too.

peopleRemove.label: Remove people from the list
peopleRemove.hint: Remove a person who is off from every list. This has no Undo.

clientsChange.label: Change client details
clientsChange.hint: Change the name and the contact details of a client.

subCompaniesManage.label: Manage sub-companies
subCompaniesManage.hint: Add, change and delete the sub-companies.

paymentView.label: See payments
paymentView.hint: See the payments of a project and the money numbers on the Dashboard.

paymentAdd.label: Add payments
paymentAdd.hint: Add a new payment to a project. Needs "See payments".

paymentChange.label: Change and delete payments
paymentChange.hint: Change the amount, the date or the note, or delete a payment. Needs "See payments".

paymentReceive.label: Mark payments received
paymentReceive.hint: Mark a payment as received, with its date. Needs "See payments".

templatesProjectCreate.label: Make project templates
templatesProjectCreate.hint: Make a new project template. You can always change your own. Today no screen lets a Member do this.

templatesProjectAny.label: Change any project template
templatesProjectAny.hint: Change or delete a project template that another person made.

templatesTaskSave.label: Save to-do templates
templatesTaskSave.hint: Save a to-do as a template, or make one by hand.

templatesTaskAny.label: Change any to-do template
templatesTaskAny.hint: Rename or delete a to-do template that another person made.

templatesUpdateProjects.label: Update projects from a template
templatesUpdateProjects.hint: Send a template change to the projects that follow it.

dashboardView.label: See the Dashboard
dashboardView.hint: Open the Dashboard, the meeting view, the map and the Open space.

workloadView.label: See the workload
workloadView.hint: See how much work each person holds. Needs "See the Dashboard".

searchUse.label: Use Search
searchUse.hint: Search projects, to-dos, people, files and messages.

gapsView.label: See the data gaps
gapsView.hint: See what the office has not filled in.

reportOffice.label: Office report
reportOffice.hint: The report of a week, a month, a quarter or a year. Today only an AI assistant reads it for you.

aiConnect.label: Connect AI assistants
aiConnect.hint: Connect an AI app to Madar. Off stops the connected assistants of this role at once.

aiReadWork.label: AI reads work data
aiReadWork.hint: Projects, to-dos, comments, posts, meetings, the Tracker, deadlines, file names, people, the Dashboard, the History and Search.

aiReadChats.label: AI reads chats
aiReadChats.hint: Direct chats, groups and project chats that the person can open. Off also hides messages in Search.

aiTodos.label: AI works on to-dos
aiTodos.hint: Add, change, finish, move, order, take and join to-dos. Approve and send back.

aiPosts.label: AI posts and comments
aiPosts.hint: Post an update on a project, and comment on a to-do.

aiMessages.label: AI sends messages
aiMessages.hint: Send a chat message as the person, and open a direct chat.

aiMeetings.label: AI plans meetings
aiMeetings.hint: Plan, change and cancel meetings, and save the minutes.

aiTracker.label: AI logs in the Tracker
aiTracker.hint: Log, change and close Tracker entries.

aiProjects.label: AI changes projects
aiProjects.hint: Change project details and status, stage dates and deadlines.

aiPayments.label: AI handles payments
aiPayments.hint: See, add and change payments. The person also needs the money rights.

aiFeedback.label: AI reads requests and bugs
aiFeedback.hint: Read the reports of the team and mark them done. The person also needs "Read requests and bugs".

aiUndo.label: AI undoes changes
aiUndo.hint: Take back a change, or all the changes of one request.

aiUndoOthers.label: Undo the changes of AI assistants
aiUndoOthers.hint: Take back a change that the AI assistant of another person made.

feedbackSend.label: Send requests and bugs
feedbackSend.hint: Send a feature request or a bug report.

feedbackManage.label: Read requests and bugs
feedbackManage.hint: Read what the team sends, and mark it done.

officeSettings.label: Change the office settings
officeSettings.hint: The default stages, the code start, the workload limit and the stale days.

2026-10-23-74.title: Rights in 112 switches
2026-10-23-74.body: Each role now has 112 switches in 13 sections. Turn on only the work that the role needs. The AI assistants of a role follow the same switches. Nothing changes for your roles today.
